ruling.explanation:
The rider's claim and the platform's own trace agree, so this dispute is decided on the numbers.

(1) The deviation is ESTABLISHED. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02830 measures the trip between the recorded pickup and drop-off events at 22.95 km against the booked optimal of 16.7 km on EV-TRIP-02830 — an excess of 6.25 km, which is 37.43% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). The trace distance governs; the rounded 22.9 km convenience copy on the trip record was not used for the threshold.

(2) The trace is not impaired. 181 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s, so none of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) fires. No independent corroboration is required, and the POL-RD-08 burden shifts to the driver.

(3) The driver's traffic excuse does not answer the finding. You say there was a massive jam on the expressway. An external-traffic excuse is tested under POL-RD-03 against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02830-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT): it names no road, carries no validity window and holds no shortest-lawful-alternative figure. POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-13 read with POL-RD-08, the assertion carries no weight — it neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because you named no evidence ID for an advisory, POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged (POL-RD-13(1)): this is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. The ruling records that the assertion was discarded and that no advisory was on file.

(4) The arithmetic. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs; the surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 16.7 + 0.28 × 22.5) × 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 23.425. Charged_total is 30.18. Refund = 30.18 − 23.425 = 6.755, rounded UP to SGD 6.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below the 90% full-refund share (22.38% of charged_total), so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.80.

(5) No additions. There are no ERP gantries, no tolls and no airport surcharge on EV-FARE-02830, so POL-RD-09 corrects nothing and nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. No rider-requested detour or relocation rescues any part of the excess: the chat log EV-CHAT-02830 is empty (0 messages), no pickup or drop-off amendment is recorded (amended_optimal_distance_km is null), and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL.

(6) Driver conduct and profiles. The deviation is not MATERIAL (37.43% is below 50%; 6.25 km is below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 profile check is not required; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 395 (ratio 0.0025), so no repeat pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift follows and no driver-conduct referral arises. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the POL-RD-08 trigger of 4, so no extra corroboration is required. No profile field outside the ones POL-GEN-01 names is used as a ground of decision; the lifetime counters mentioned in the papers are context only.

(7) No escalation, and no referral. Confidence 0.95 is above the 0.70 floor. The trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, no timestamps conflict, no charge line is unmatched, and the trace is unimpaired. The monetary effect of SGD 6.80 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically on issue.

Confidence is 0.95. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-GPS-02830, EV-TRIP-02830 and EV-FARE-02830 — sits at weight 1.0. The 0.0-weight advisory EV-ADVIS-02830-01 is not relied on and does not enter the confidence cap; it is recorded only as an absence. The referrals list is empty because no clause produces one. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal it once within 30 days to the platform's help channel (POL-GEN-04).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
